<script type="text/plain" id="cv-document-styles">
/* COLORS */
:root {
  --accent: #3157c8;
  --ink: #172033;
  --muted: #5e687a;
  --rule: #879fe8;
}

/* PAGE */
* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  background: #eef1f7;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 10.5pt;
  line-height: 1.18;
}

main.content {
  max-width: 8.5in;
  min-height: 11in;
  margin: 1.5rem auto;
  padding: 0.62in 0.68in 0.56in;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgb(23 32 51 / 10%);
}

#title-block-header {
  display: none;
}

/* HEADER */
.cv-name {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 28pt;
  line-height: 1.14;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.cv-contact {
  margin: 0.3em 0 1.05em;
  font-size: 15pt;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

a:hover,
a:focus {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.cv-contact a {
  color: var(--muted);
}

/* SECTIONS */
.cv-section {
  margin-top: 0.78em;
}

.cv-section h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.52em;
  padding-bottom: 0.34em;
  border-bottom: 0.8pt solid var(--rule);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 14.5pt;
  line-height: 1.17;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}

.entry {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 8.5em;
  column-gap: 1.2em;
  margin-bottom: 0.25em;
  break-inside: avoid;
}

.entry-main {
  min-width: 0;
}

.entry-title {
  font-weight: 700;
}

.entry-detail {
  color: var(--muted);
}

.entry-subtitle {
  font-style: italic;
}

.entry-date {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.92em;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: right;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ENTRY SPACING */
.research {
  margin-bottom: 0.52em;
}

.research .description {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  margin-top: 0.28em;
}

.page-break {
  break-before: page;
  margin-top: 2.2em;
}

/* SMALL SCREEN */
@media (max-width: 680px) {
  main.content {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: auto;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 2rem 1.25rem;
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .entry {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    row-gap: 0.15em;
  }

  .entry-date {
    grid-row: auto;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .research .description {
    grid-column: 1;
  }
}

/* PRINT */
@media print {
  @page {
    size: letter;
    margin: 0.62in 0.68in 0.56in;
  }

  html {
    background: #fff;
  }

  body {
    print-color-adjust: exact;
    -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
  }

  main.content {
    width: 8.5in;
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .page-break {
    margin-top: 0;
  }
}
</script>

<script>
(() => {
  const frame = document.getElementById("cv-frame");
  const styles = document.getElementById("cv-document-styles").textContent;
  const content = document.getElementById("cv-document-template").innerHTML;
  const pdfDownload = document.getElementById("cv-pdf-download");

  const standaloneDocument = [
    "<!doctype html>",
    '<html lang="en">',
    "<head>",
    '<meta charset="utf-8">',
    '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">',
    "<title>CV-Arkadiusz-Lipiecki</title>",
    '<base target="_blank">',
    `<style>${styles}</style>`,
    "</head>",
    "<body>",
    content,
    "</body>",
    "</html>"
  ].join("");

  frame.addEventListener("load", () => {
    const resizeFrame = () => {
      const documentHeight = frame.contentDocument.documentElement.scrollHeight;
      frame.style.height = `${documentHeight}px`;
    };

    resizeFrame();
    new ResizeObserver(resizeFrame).observe(frame.contentDocument.documentElement);
  });

  pdfDownload.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    frame.contentWindow.focus();
    frame.contentWindow.print();
  });

  frame.srcdoc = standaloneDocument;
})();
</script>
